title: About Luke Caldwell: Frequently Asked Questions

blocks.text: Welcome to the official FAQ page for Luke Caldwell. Here, we address some of the most common questions about Luke’s career, design philosophy, and his involvement with Timber + Love and the Boise community.

Luke Caldwell is a designer, builder, and entrepreneur based in Boise, Idaho. He is known for co-starring on HGTV’s “Boise Boys” and for founding Timber + Love in 2015, a design-build firm that creates custom homes and renovations in the Treasure Valley.
How did Luke Caldwell get started in real estate and design?

Luke began his career in Treasure Valley real estate and developing a passion for transforming properties. What started as home investment and renovation evolved into a deeper commitment to intentional design and quality construction, eventually leading to the founding of Timber + Love and his national platform on HGTV’s “Boise Boys.”

Timber + Love is Luke Caldwell’s design-build firm based in Boise, Idaho. The company specializes in creating custom homes and undertaking extensive renovations, offering a seamless, integrated approach from initial design concepts through final construction. Timber + Love is known for its commitment to quality craftsmanship, innovative design, and supporting local Boise businesses and trades. Luke prioritizes local subcontractors and skilled tradespeople on every project, keeping economic impact inside the community.
What is Luke Caldwell’s design philosophy?

Luke believes that great design must be both beautiful and livable. His approach at Timber + Love centers on intentionality. Every material choice, spatial decision, and finish is deliberate. He favors designs that honor the character of a space while elevating it for modern life. Quality craftsmanship, sustainability, and deep respect for the client’s vision are non-negotiables on every project.

“Boise Boys” was a popular television series on HGTV that featured Luke Caldwell and Clint Robertson transforming homes in the Boise area. The show highlighted their unique design aesthetic, construction expertise, and the vibrant real estate market of the Treasure Valley. It brought national attention to the quality and creativity happening in Boise’s design-build industry.
Will Luke Caldwell be on TV again?

Yes! Luke Caldwell and Clint Robertson have announced a new independent series called “Building Boise.” This show will continue to feature their design and renovation projects in the Treasure Valley, offering fans a fresh look at their latest work and insights into the local market. Details regarding viewing platforms and release dates will be announced soon.
Is Luke Caldwell involved in community initiatives?

Absolutely. Luke is deeply committed to giving back to his community. Timber + Love actively supports the local economy by prioritizing local subcontractors and sourcing materials from Boise-area businesses. Through “Building Boise,” Luke’s mission is to celebrate the craftspeople, tradespeople, and entrepreneurs who make the Treasure Valley exceptional, and to inspire others with what’s possible here.
What is Luke’s role in the Boise real estate market outside of design-build?

Luke’s primary focus is Timber + Love, but his work naturally intersects with the broader Boise real estate market. Through his firm, he significantly contributes to the high-end residential sector, enhancing property values and introducing cutting-edge design. His insights are frequently sought regarding local market trends and design innovation, a reflection of his 20+ years of hands-on experience in the Treasure Valley.
